title: Opening: name, date and first reel
summary: Joseph gives his full name, how his mother chose it, and the date, 10 June 1969.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape

blocks.x: Let's get your name down the first thing.

Well, my mother told me, uh, like, she named me after a priest. Uh, some relatives, uh, that she know that, uh, their son went over to his, uh, seminar, and he became a priest, and so she gave me his name, Gerald. And the Thaddeus? Well, uh, I never questioned about that name, Thaddeus. Uh-huh.
Yeah. Oh, let's see, what's today's date? I'm trying to write it down here on the bottom.
Uh, June the 10th. June the 10th. 1969. Yeah. Okay.
Well, good enough, I got that filled in, uh, and it's the first reel.
